data.name: Kritanjali
data.gender_notes: Kritanjali is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Krita signifies 'praise' or 'done'. Anjali means 'offering' or 'pledge'. This name symbolizes the love and devotion offered to the divine. The name Kritanjali carries the meaning “Pledge of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kritanjali usually hope their child will grow to embody pledge of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sacred commitment to the divine
data.etymology: Kritanjali belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pledge of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kritanjali total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kritanjali" holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as it reflects the tradition of offering praises and devotional homages to the deities. During religious rituals and ceremonies, devotees make an "anjali", a ritualistic offering of hands in prayer as a symbol of submission and respect. The term "Kritanjali" thus represents a beautiful amalgamation of devotion, respect, and love for the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kritanjali" carries deep spiritual significance as it inspires one to offer their life, actions, and thoughts in dedication to their chosen deity. It embodies the values of faith, humility, and gratitude, inspiring one to approach the divine with a heart filled with love, devotion, and surrender. In the spiritual journey, the name is a constant reminder to keep the focus on the divine and offer all actions as an offering or "anjali" to the universe and all its manifestations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kritanjali: Pursuer of Truth and Righteousness. A soul dedicated to the continuous quest for knowledge and virtue.
